Personally I'd do strength stuff first then cardio
you don't seem to have a structured program which would help, but it's fine as long as you keep overloading and progressing.
when counting weight you count totall weight so your bench sets were 20, 25 and 30kgs . Again I'd personally do squats before leg press, because imo squats are more beneficial and this way you won't tire yourself by legpressing. By the way no one cares how much you leg press. Goblet squats are fine, I'd try to graduate to barbell squats over time. Dips are great just try to graduate to doing bodyweight dips, doesn't need to be high amount of reps at the begining.
You don't seem to do back which is huge mistake. Over time bench and dips will strengthen your chest which will pull your shoulder to the front and result in upper back rounding and I imagine you don't want that. So to combat this you need to strengthen your back chin ups, pull ups, db/bb rows, lat pulldowns etc are all fine just pick 1 or 2 you like and do it.
Anyway since it seems that you're beginner it'd be easier for you to pick a program which has build in progression, deloads and is balanced. Also if you're doing full body workouts it'd be ideal to have a rest day so your body can recover in time.
Feel free to pm if you have any questions
